summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Cambria Tax Aware ETF (TAX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund actively selects US stocks with value and quality characteristics and low or no dividend yields. The fund aims to generate capital appreciation without distributing high dividend income or taxable gains TAX was launched on Dec 18, 2024 and is issued by Cambria.

holdings.infoBox: TAX is an equity ETF with a total of 100 individual holdings. The top holdings are Advanced Micro Devices stock at 2.43%, Twilio at 2.33%, Revolution Medicines at 1.93%, Natera at 1.69%, and Flex Ltd. at 1.63%.
